mapper.sql: c.id as comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.created_at, u.nickname, u.avatar
mapper.insert: insert into post_comments(id, post_id, user_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{commentId}, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, 'active', current_timestamp, current_timestamp)
mapper.select:
select
from post_comments c join users u on u.id = c.user_id where c.post_id = #{postId} and c.status = 'active' order by c.created_at desc, c.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select
from post_comments c join users u on u.id = c.user_id where c.id = #{commentId} and c.status = 'active'
